A.definition: Same test, different label: both tools ran the same test but print it under a different name.
A.use: Labels are never compared, only numbers. No record should get A.

B.definition: Different test family because of sparse cells: expected count < 5, so EasyTableOne ran Fisher where the other tool ran chi-square.
B.use: Must be 0. R is told which variables use Fisher (exact = c(...)). Any B record is a setup bug.

C.definition: Mann–Whitney U (with continuity correction) vs Kruskal–Wallis.
C.use: Must be 0. R runs wilcox.test for 2 groups with the same continuity and exact settings. Any C record is a setup bug.

D.definition: Standardised difference undefined because a group has n < 2. EasyTableOne drops it; the other tool may return a finite value.

D2.definition: Different multi-group SMD definition (R reports the mean of pairwise SMDs).
D2.use: New for R4; mark not comparable unless the definitions coincide.

E.definition: A statistic that one or both tools do not output.

F.definition: A test result that one or both tools do not output.

G.definition: EasyTableOne declined to test (a group has no valid observations) but the other tool returned a result.

H.definition: Monte Carlo P value, compared under the Monte Carlo tolerance.
H.use: New for R4. Counts as compared, not as not comparable.
